performanceTask.title: Share what you learned in one minute
performanceTask.scenario: Trong buổi chia sẻ hằng tuần, bạn kể ngắn về một công cụ mới mà bạn vừa thử.
performanceTask.baselinePrompt: Nói bằng tiếng Anh trong khoảng một phút: công cụ làm gì, bạn đã thử gì, một khó khăn và một lời khuyên. Chưa xem bài mẫu.
performanceTask.performancePrompt: Speak in English for about one minute: what the tool does, what you tried, one difficulty and one tip for your teammates.
performanceTask.modelResponse: This week I tried a tool called Taskflow. Taskflow is a tool that runs scripts on a schedule, for example every night at two o'clock. I tried a daily backup script, and it ran without problems after a ten-minute setup. The hardest part was the time zone setting, because the default is UTC, so my first job ran at the wrong hour. I found the answer in the documentation, and now I always set the time zone in the file. The tool has a gentle learning curve, and the logs are easy to read. My tip for you is to start with a small script and check the logs after the first run. If you try it, please tell me what you think.
performanceTask.retryPrompt: Share again in English. Keep the four parts and make the difficulty more specific.
performanceTask.transferPrompt: Share what you learned about a different tool, with the same four parts.
performanceTask.reviewPrompt: Share about another tool without looking at old notes.
